title: CR-Harness Resources & News
blurb: Curated pointers for Mini Royale / CR-Harness — an AI/LLM control research platform built around a simplified Clash Royale–style 1v1 simulator.

resources.title: Official bilingual docs site (README-linked)
resources.why: Canonical public documentation promised by the project README (EN + 中文). As of 2026-09-24 the Pages site returned 404 — keep the link; it may go live when Pages is enabled.

resources.title: CR-Harness-main (private GitHub repo)
resources.why: Python research codebase: mini_royale core engine, ai_control translation layer (:8787), web cockpit (:8080), ETL metrics (EDR / KVR / whiff rate). Access required.

resources.title: Decision-point / legal_actions control protocol
resources.why: Core research idea from the README: the game emits decision_point snapshots with a legal_actions whitelist; the LLM may only pick action_ids (no invented coordinates). Invalid IDs drop; empty/timeout → noop. Async requests; engine revalidates on apply.

resources.title: ETL + agent evaluation loop
resources.why: Every match writes raw JSONL then ETL CSVs (timeseries, deploys, decisions, combos, decision_context, events) plus aggregate.csv. evaluate_agents.py runs batch matches → JSON report + HTML dashboard.

resources.title: Contribution workflow: issue → AI implementation → PR review
resources.why: Repo norm (docs/CONTRIBUTING.en.md): humans file issues; AI (Claude Code) plans + implements + opens PRs; humans review/approve/merge. Prefer squash merge. Private + free-plan so branch protection is voluntary discipline.

resources.title: AI Control (UK AISI / Redwood research lineage)
resources.why: Public research framing for evaluating protocols that keep useful work flowing from untrusted models — conceptually adjacent to CR-Harness’s whitelist / decision_point control surface (not a code dependency).

resources.title: Inspect AI — UK AISI evaluation framework
resources.why: Open evaluation harness for LLM agents/tasks. Useful companion reading when designing batch evals and decision logging around CR-Harness.

resources.title: OpenAI Evals
resources.why: Public eval scaffolding for model behavior. Relevant when comparing CR-Harness batch agent evaluation patterns to broader LLM eval practice.

news.title: CR-Harness section added to TonyZhou05 research hub
news.summary: Public hub pages for resources/news and a mirrored issues/PR board, without publishing private code or credentials. Source of truth remains the private CR-Harness-main repo.

news.title: Open board snapshot: 8 issues, 2 PRs
news.summary: Active threads include deployment-grid whitelist anchors (#256), sampled delta-mode parallelism (#251), orphaned cockpit poll / error_category (#245→PR #246), card-manual harness plugin (#201/#200), batch LLM-call diagnostics (#67→draft PR #68), lane_bonus fix (#23), and pause-during-inference (#3).
